title: WIDGET SIZES ON IPHONES
body: In short, I prefer the Android version — the widget is more flexible, resizable, and actually useful. I can stretch it to show more events without scrolling, turning my Home Screen into a proper schedule dashboard. Meanwhile… to my friends on iOS: please tell Apple to do something about those fixed widget sizes. It’s 2025 — we deserve a calendar widget that can actually breathe.
author: Sonatina16
